Name: SK's Core Editor
Author: seifkingSK
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ossn6o7.png[/img]
[url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mqL6Uu.png[/img][/url] [url=https://smapi.io/][img]https://i.imgur.com/z1YXh1a.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54492][img]https://i.imgur.com/pu4KdGu.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43861][img]https://i.imgur.com/VvoEt1m.png[/img][/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/Q0tj0B7.png[/img][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UINQfef.png[/img]
[left][size=4]SK's Core Editor is an in-game editor for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54473][color=#e69138]Junimo Bundles Plus[/color][/url]'s bundles and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54522][color=#e69138]Interactive Community Centre[/color][/url]'s Orders Board orders: hand-tune the Junimo bundles, or write your own bundles and orders, without touching JSON.[/size]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/TVLxM2L.png[/img][/center]
[size=4][i]- Opened from a small button in the corner of the [b]title screen[/b] (before loading a save), no keybind.
- [b]Junimo Bundles[/b]: edit Junimo Remix bundle definitions with live previews of the items each bundle and slot can draw.
- [b]Item Rules[/b]: exclusions, high-difficulty-only tags, quantity caps, manual tags and mod allow-lists.
- [b]Reward Classes[/b], with a live roll preview, and the Kitchen's [b]Delivery Pool[/b].
- [b]Vanilla Plus[/b]: change the game's Normal or Remixed bundles or add new ones, with an [b]Add item[/b] window that only offers qualities an item can reach.
- [b]Full Bundles preview[/b]: shows the whole set a new save would get, from Junimo Remix, with your unsaved edits, or Vanilla Plus.
- [b]Orders[/b]: requester, NPC and drop-box pickers, chips for conditions and tags, plain-text fields saved as translations, and an attachment builder for reward letters.
- [b]Drop Boxes[/b]: add your own drop boxes for orders, placed right on the map with a preview of the box and its arrow.
- [b]Pantry Loot[/b]: what the Pantry's shelf and crates give, with a per-season preview of each line's items.
- [b]Shipped and pack tabs[/b]: each list shows what came with the mod and what's in your pack, overrides included; new entries start from [b]＋[/b].
- [b]Edit target[/b]: each mod's hub has its own; pick your content pack, or make a new one from inside the game, ready to save into right away.
- [b]Overrides[/b]: the Junimo bundles, reward pools and Vanilla Plus bundles that come with Junimo Bundles Plus are read-only; Override one and only your changes go into your content pack, so mod updates never overwrite them.
- Text follows the game's language, for translators: with the game in another language you edit that language's file, and anything not translated yet is marked.
- [b]Expression Builder[/b]: build and test the tag expressions bundles and orders use, with a live list of matching items.
- Shows each mod's own data and edits any installed content pack's: content-pack authors can use it instead of hand-writing files.[/i][/size][/left]

[quote][i]Want to know what the editor writes, or edit the files by hand? Each mod has its authoring guides. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54473][color=#e69138]Junimo Bundles Plus[/color][/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4522]Content Pack Authoring: Junimo Remix[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4523]Content Pack Authoring: Vanilla Plus[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54522][color=#e69138]Interactive Community Centre[/color][/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4525]Orders Board Authoring[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4553]Drop Boxes Authoring[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4554]Pantry Loot Authoring[/url].[/i][/quote]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Uohxu8h.png[/img]
[center][size=4][b][color=#e69138]1.[/color][/b] Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/][color=#e69138]SMAPI[/color][/url].
[b][color=#e69138]2.[/color][/b] Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54492][color=#e69138]SK's Core Engine[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43861][color=#e69138]StardewUI Continued[/color][/url] (both required).
[b][color=#e69138]3.[/color][/b] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54473][color=#e69138]Junimo Bundles Plus[/color][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54522][color=#e69138]Interactive Community Centre[/color][/url], or both: the editor shows the screens of the ones you have.
[b][color=#e69138]4.[/color][/b] Download this mod and drop it in your [color=#f4f4f4]Mods[/color] folder.[/size][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/efem2sa.png[/img]
[center][size=4][i]- No known limitations found yet.[/i][/size][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PoPsPXp.png[/img]
[center][size=4]Text is in English for now, and translations from native speakers are welcome. The mod's [color=#f4f4f4]i18n[/color] folder already has a file for every language the game supports ([color=#f4f4f4]de, es, fr, hu, it, ja, ko, pt, ru, tr, zh[/color]), filled with the English text. Translate the lines in your language's file and send it in a post or private message here: I'll add it in the next update and credit you.[/size][/center]
[center][size=4][i]- No translations yet: every language is open.[/i][/size][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qXg7DRQ.png[/img]
[left][b]Can it break my save?[/b]
No. Everything it edits is a plain data file. Bundles are baked into a save when it's created, so bundle edits apply to new saves; order edits apply as soon as you save them.

[b]Where are my edits saved?[/b]
Into the content pack you pick as the Edit target. A pack's own entries save back to that pack; changes to the mods' built-in bundles, reward pools and Vanilla Plus bundles are saved as overrides in your pack, which mod updates never touch. The orders that come with Interactive are read-only; turn single ones off on its Built-in orders settings page.[/left]
